description: Group itinerary stops geographically or find nearby restaurants, sights, walking routes and areas around a coordinate (lat, lon) or an existing place (place_id), sorted by distance_km.

family.description: Optional broad family filter (e.g. food, sights, drinks).

lat.description: Center latitude (required unless place_id is provided).

lon.description: Center longitude (required unless place_id is provided).

place_id.description: Existing place ID or slug to search around instead of lat/lon.

name: find_nearby
title: Find Nearby Places, Routes and Areas
